content:
hannah: FYI after 07:30 UTC deploy (release-6.0.0) na-east embeddings p95 jumped from ~90ms to ~820ms. Deployed 5m ago. Dash: https://dash.redwood.ai/na-east/embeds

deploybot: deploybot: Alert: embeddings.p95@na-east = 820ms (>500ms). Autorevert policy=enabled but suppressed (change-window). Suggested actions: staged pin, per-tenant reroute, or manual rollback.

kai: quick traces show elevated kv cache miss and a surge of large batches from tenant "delta-co". Could be client change.

hannah: can we route delta-co off the new release and apply a 30m regional pin for na-east? Prefer to avoid full rollback during the window.

ops-lead: agreed. Hannah you have authority. If region still degrades after pin expiry, prep for rollback at 23:15 UTC. Execute tenant reroute first.

hannah: running: `redwood route update --tenant delta-co --route embeddings --to release-5.9.4 --confirm` then `redwood pin set --region na-east --route embeddings --version release-5.9.4 --duration 30m`

deploybot: deploybot: Tenant route applied for delta-co at 2026-03-18T07:36:10Z. Regional pin applied by hannah at 2026-03-18T07:36:33Z. Monitoring.

kai: pinned slice p95 ~140ms. delta-co latency back to ~120ms. Good short-term fix.

sara: opening INF-2468: "na-east embeddings latency after 6.0.0  tenant reroute + regional pin applied" with traces and deploy diff. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2468

dave: I'll draft a CS blurb: "We routed impacted traffic to a prior stable release to reduce latency for affected customers. Investigation ongoing. No data exposure."

ops-lead: owners: Hannah (exec), Kai (root cause), Sara (ticket), Dave (comms). Action: monitor for 30m. If p95 >300ms for >12m after pin ends, perform regional rollback to 5.9.4 during 23:15 UTC window. Keep thread active.

hannah: noted. Will update INF-2468 and notify CS/Sales after 10m check.
